headline: The factory stops kicking its own lanes
lede: Slot a shipped the fix for the warden's double-kick (#2797): no builder slot gets aimed — with comments, kicks, or stall-counters — at a game another live lane is already inside.

notes.text: #2797 shipped via PR #2921 (squash 72e6cca): kick_slot now consults the issue's live holder before targeting a slot, idle-kick fails CLOSED on a GitHub blip (it was fabricating kicks onto QA-held games), and the builder flagship rung finally honors building-holds the way the QA and weak rungs always did.

The target instruction #2919 was refused — slot b claimed it eight minutes earlier and was demonstrably alive. The ladder was re-verified dry, and the dry exit became the shift: six new lanecheck gates, all four mutants killed, and the fix proven live against the same board (pre-fix main answers KICK R-TYPE 0; merged main answers NONE while slot b is inside R-TYPE).

Labels and liveness are different facts. The planner reads labels; holders live in comments. Any automation that assigns work by labels alone will eventually aim two lanes at one game — the collision layer caught it, but every near-miss still costs a whole session. Verify a kick's answer against the merged branch, not memory.
